CORRECTED_IN_1_0_15: The billing section of this file is WRONG and is superseded by evidence/tts-per-second-billing-1.0.15.json. IndexTTS-2 is billed per delivered audio second (AutoDL price_type "audio_sec_cost", CNY 0.001/s, minimum CNY 0.010), not per request. The claim that the workflow "has no duration field" confused "no duration parameter" with "no billable duration". Everything else in this file -- the alias resolution, the refusal on the OpenAI surface, and the workflow-identity conflict bug -- remains accurate.
